citation.authors: Habek M, Ruška B, Crnošija L, Adamec I, Junaković A, Krbot Skorić M
citation.title: Effect of Food Intake on Hemodynamic Parameters during the Tilt-Table Test in Patients with Postural Orthostatic Tachycardia Syndrome

population.description: Group D, the healthy control group: 10 healthy individuals, 6 female, age 24.25±2.25 years (mean±SD, Results paragraph 1 and Table 1). Called healthy by the paper, with no history of events associated with orthostatic intolerance; no glucose test is reported. The min and max are not printed, so null (the model draws from mean±2 sd). BMI is not printed for group D.

protocols.name: pre_meal_supine
protocols.description: Tilt-table test, first phase only: 10 min supine before any tilt or meal (Results: 10-min supine phase is phase 1 of five). The paper says only that participants 'had fasted for at least 3 hours prior to the testing', a lower bound and no last-meal contents, so the arm starts from typical values (norm_center) with no meal; only heart rate and blood pressure are entered. Clock hour not printed, so 8.0 is assumed. The arm ends after the supine phase.

findings.description: Systolic BP, supine, healthy group D (n=10), before the meal: mean over the 10-min supine phase (the paper prints one supine value per group and does not say whether it is a mean over the phase or an end value; the window is the 10-min phase)

left_out.what: tilted rows (70 degree tilt) of sBP, dBP and HR, before and after the meal, all four groups (Table 1, 'Tilted' rows); the standing-minus-supine HR increments (Results; Fig. 3); and the post-meal supine rows of sBP, dBP and HR for healthy group D (Table 1, After meal), because the meal follows a 10-min 70 degree tilt that the model cannot express
supine sBP, dBP and HR before and after the meal, groups A, B and C (Table 1; n=13, 12, 16): patients with orthostatic intolerance (POTS and vasovagal syncope), not a healthy group
groups A, B and C as defined by their tilt response (dHR before the meal of 30 or more, or below 30 before and at or above 30 after; Methods): the groups are split by the measurement itself
